source.title: Scrambling Program Update: TNoodle 0.7.12
source.content:
The WRC is changing the official scrambling program from TNoodle 0.7.8 to TNoodle 0.7.12. This addresses two minor issues:
 
 - Remove the reference to slice moves in the FMC sheet. (Slice moves have never been allowed since TNoodle has been official.)
 - Document scramble filtering in the readme.
 
 Please remember that official competitions must always use the current version of the official scramble program. This is always available from: [https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)

translation.title: 打乱程序更新：TNoodle 0.7.12
translation.content:
WCA 规则委员会（WRC）将官方打乱程序从 TNoodle 0.7.8 更换为 TNoodle 0.7.12，以解决两个小问题：

* 删除最少步答题纸中关于中层转动的说明。自 TNoodle 成为官方打乱程序起，中层转动就从未被允许使用。
* 在 README 中说明打乱筛选方式。

请记住，官方比赛必须始终使用当前版本的官方打乱程序。最新版本可从以下页面获取：[https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/scrambles/)
